source_time_cet.evidence: Specification section 3.1, printed page 10: UTC/GMT+1; source DATE grids match exactly

time_utc.transform: subtract fixed one hour, no DST rule or shift selected from fit
time_utc.limit: The publisher does not explicitly identify within-bin timestamp phase. End labels are inferred from 18:10 first row versus 18:00 experiment start; dynamics treat all co-labelled records as means of the same bin.

indoor_temperature_mean_c.evidence: Specification section 5.1 instrumentation; section 6.1 N2 measured room air temperatures @110 cm
indoor_temperature_mean_c.transform: floor-area-weighted mean of room-centre sensor temperatures
indoor_temperature_mean_c.aggregation_identity: derived observation aggregate; not a direct measured volume-mean state or period-end temperature

room_floor_areas.evidence: Specification Figure 9, printed page 16 (PDF page 17); Table 12, printed page 29 (PDF page 30)

outdoor_temperature_mean_c.evidence: Specification section 3.16: weather measured on site at minute intervals, provided 10-minute and hourly averages

measured_room_heating_kw.transform: sum of room electrical heater channels divided by 1000
measured_room_heating_kw.evidence: Specification sections 3.9, 5.1 and 6.1 N2 electric heating; nominal 2 kW heater measured 1.80-1.93 kW; actual workbook maxima 1790-1880 W for ordinary heated rooms
measured_room_heating_kw.limit: Electricity input is measured. Unity conversion into room heat is model assumption; heater mass and radiative/convective dynamics are not independently represented.

measured_internal_gain_kw.raw_columns: available n2_aroom_{room}_IHS_elP channels only; no ventilation *_SUA_IHS_elP or calculated DHW
measured_internal_gain_kw.evidence: Specification section 6.1 N2: measured heater+IHS total split in some rooms according to scheduled IHS; their combined sum is used in RC
measured_internal_gain_kw.limit: The split between heating and IHS is publisher-calculated for single-heater rooms. Both parts are reunited in total_room_heat_input_kw, rather than claiming two independent meters.

total_room_heat_input_kw.omitted: socket/fan heat, ventilation losses, attic/cellar storage and interroom exchange are not separately included

global_irradiance_w_m2.evidence: Specification sections 3.16 and 5.1 on-site solar radiation

solar_reference_kw_m2.transform: maximum same-bin global and vertical facade irradiance divided by 1000
solar_reference_kw_m2.identity: declared effective irradiance proxy for bounded window gain, not measured transmitted solar heat

effective_solar_area_upper_bound.evidence: Figure 9 window counts and Table 2 glass areas: six type 1, one each type 2/3/4/5; total 16.77 m2. Section 3.5 manufacturer normal-incidence SHGC 0.62
effective_solar_area_upper_bound.transform: 16.77*0.62; maximum-of-facades input makes this a conservative aggregate window-gain limit
effective_solar_area_upper_bound.limit: SHGC is supplier reference, not a new local measurement. Opaque solar absorption is omitted.

H_C_parameters.identity: constrained estimates from training portion of this external processed-measurement aggregate; not source-certified whole-house fabric values and not Wuhan parameters
H_C_parameters.bounds_identity: analyst positive ranges registered before fitting

processing_evidence.short_gap_fills: Specification section 6.2, printed page 54 (PDF page 55): short measurement failures filled with temperature linear interpolation and power/flow zero; no row flags supplied
processing_evidence.excluded_simulated_refill: Section 6.2, printed page 55 (PDF page 56): O5 2018-12-24/25 electrical heating refill simulated. Only N2 is selected, not O5.
processing_evidence.sampling: Section 5.1: instrument values measured at 1 second and stored as 1 minute means; provided workbooks are 10-minute mean versions. Exact mean observation equation is used instead of relabelling means as endpoint states.
processing_evidence.synthetic_users: Experimental occupant/control schedules are designed inputs; physical temperature and electrical measurements remain experimental observations. Calculated occupancy/DHW schedules are not used as observed heat channels.
